from pathlib import Path
from openpyxl import load_workbook
import re
files=sorted(Path('inputs/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS').glob('*.xlsx'))
ids=[]
for p in files:
 m=re.search(r'CHIP_(.+)\\.xlsx"'$'"',p.name); x=m.group(1)
 ids.append(x.split('-')[0] if x[0].isdigit() else x)
ws=load_workbook('inputs/230215_Trio_Status.xlsx',data_only=True).active
meta=[str(r[0]) for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True)]
print('files',len(files),'metadata',len(meta))
print('metadata absent file',sorted(set(meta)-set(ids)))
print('files absent metadata',sorted(set(ids)-set(meta)))
print('\\nRows around family / relevant IDs:')
for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True):
 if str(r[0]) in {'380','381','533','353','354'}: print(r)
print('\\nfilenames numeric around 350-550:')
for p,x in zip(files,ids):
 if x.isdigit() and 340<=int(x)<=540: print(p.name)
